text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohh~! It's Smart Falcon--!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: 1st place... Did I...?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon-san, take the center 
position!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! Falco, taking center stage...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon! Falco~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So this is the Classic...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is—the view from the top of the 
Umadol world...!

—That day. Bathed in the cheers of a 
packed crowd, singing and dancing at 
center stage... She was shining brighter 
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: D-Did my song... reach you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers were so loud that 
halfway through, I couldn't hear the 
music...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “I see... I get it now~...!”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then it reached them. To everyone, each 
and every one of them, my—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That was so much funーー!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! The top stage is so incredible!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's penlights were brighter than 
the spotlights! Everything right before my 
eyes was sparkling so brightly!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The sense of unity was just amazing...! 
Everyone's feelings were completely 
aligned with mine!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you get it!? Am I getting through to 
you!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I want to see that view... on 
the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to create the world's number one 
stage, bursting and blazing with 
brilliance...!

Smart Falcon looks unusually serious. 
Having experienced what it's like at the 
top—a goal that once felt abstract—her 
desire to make her dream a reality seems 
to have grown even stronger.

And the same was true for me as I watched 
her sing and dance on that ultimate stage!
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's see this view from the 
dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —Definitely!

Having returned to the waiting room and 
calmed down a bit, she made a suggestion 
about what to do going forward. That 
was...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco wants to run in a dirt GⅠ race next!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need to shed the 'rookie' title already. 
In Umadol terms, it's time to take the 
next step.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I think that means a GⅠ... stepping onto 
a grand stage and making a name 
nationwide!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in GⅠ races just like the 
Satsuki Sho!"

"With her current ability, she can easily 
hold her own even in a GⅠ packed with top 
contenders. If that's the case—"

"Just like the Satsuki Sho, it's a race 
that can only be challenged during the 
Classic Year. I truly want her to seize 
victory in it now."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me! Or rather, any GⅠ race 
works for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't that many Dirt GⅠs anyway... 
so I'm entering every single stage I can 
stand on!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Japan Dirt Derby! Time to take 
on the top of the dirt division~☆

And so, the next goal was set: the Japan 
Dirt Derby!
